children: announced today that its third quarter 2026 financial results will be released on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, prior to the market opening. The earnings announcement, and accompanying earnings presentation, will be available on the company’s website at
The company will host a live, audio only, earnings call webcast at 9:30 a.m. ET the same day. This webcast can be accessed on the company’s website at

Driven by a shared purpose to solve our customers’ toughest problems, our employees define possible every day.

title: Northrop Grumman Announces Date for Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Webcast
